```pddl
; PDDL Plan for Preparing the Bathroom for a Bath

; Subtask 1: Fill the Bathtub with Warm Water
(:durative-action fill-bathtub
  :parameters (?robot - robot ?faucet - Faucet)
  :duration (= ?duration 3) ; Assuming it takes 3 minutes to fill the bathtub
  :condition (and
    (at start (not (inaction ?robot)))
    (at start (at ?robot ?faucet))
  )
  :effect (and
    (at start (switch-on ?robot ?faucet))
    (at end (switch-off ?robot ?faucet))
  )
)

; Subtask 2: Place a Towel Nearby
(:durative-action place-towel
  :parameters (?robot - robot ?towel - Towel ?towelHolder - TowelHolder)
  :duration (= ?duration 2) ; Assuming it takes 2 minutes to place the towel
  :condition (and
    (at start (not (inaction ?robot)))
    (at start (at ?robot ?towel))
    (at start (holding ?robot ?towel))
    (at start (at ?robot ?towelHolder))
  )
  :effect (and
    (at end (at-location ?towel ?towelHolder))
    (at end (not (holding ?robot ?towel)))
  )
)

; Subtask 3: Ensure the Bathroom is Clean
(:durative-action clean-bathroom
  :parameters (?robot - robot ?floor - Floor ?sink - Sink ?toilet - Toilet)
  :duration (= ?duration 5) ; Assuming it takes 5 minutes to clean the bathroom
  :condition (and
    (at start (not (inaction ?robot)))
    (at start (at ?robot ?floor))
    (at start (at ?robot ?sink))
    (at start (at ?robot ?toilet))
  )
  :effect (and
    (at end (cleaned ?robot ?floor))
    (at end (cleaned ?robot ?sink))
    (at end (cleaned ?robot ?toilet))
  )
)

; Plan Execution
; Assign robots to tasks based on their skills and capabilities
(:plan
  (parallel
    (fill-bathtub robot4 Faucet)
    (place-towel robot3 Towel TowelHolder)
    (clean-bathroom robot2 Floor Sink Toilet)
  )
)
```
